voyage.currentStatus: Sailing toward Tenerife after three medical evacuees were airlifted from Cape Verde to the Netherlands on May 6. Spain's latest plan is for the vessel to anchor off Granadilla rather than dock; passengers will be evaluated on board, then moved under a controlled transfer and repatriation operation without contact with the local public.

ports.name: Ushuaia
ports.note: Departure port. Ship had been based here since November 16, 2025 conducting Antarctic voyages. Investigators are looking at potential ANDV exposure before boarding — the deceased Dutch couple had also travelled through Argentina, Chile, and Uruguay before embarking.

ports.name: Saint Helena
ports.note: Body of the first deceased Dutch passenger was disembarked here on April 24. His wife flew onward to South Africa.

ports.name: Ascension Island
ports.note: British male passenger medically evacuated to South Africa from here on April 27.

ports.name: Praia (anchored offshore)
ports.note: Cape Verde declined to permit docking. On May 6, three patients were transferred by ambulance to Praia airport and airlifted to the Netherlands aboard two specialised medical aircraft.

ports.name: Granadilla, Tenerife anchorage (planned)
ports.note: Latest Spanish/Canary Islands plan: the ship is expected to anchor off Granadilla rather than dock. Passengers will be assessed on board and leave only for controlled transfer or repatriation, with no contact with the local population.

disclaimer: Itinerary compiled from Oceanwide Expeditions' press timeline, ECDC assessment, El País voyage reconstruction, BBC and Le Monde reporting, and the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs medical-evacuation statement. Latitudes and longitudes are approximate centers of each port or anchorage.
